key_highlights: ASX ends volatile week higher, but housing 'perfect storm' and deteriorating auction sentiment signal underlying fragility
Housing inflation remains a persistent RBA constraint, limiting rate-cut flexibility
Pilbara iron ore activity booms; Gateway Resources discovers 7km gold trend in WA
Virgin Australia (QAN.AX) insulated from oil shock via fuel hedging and new fleet
Consumer caution intensifies: retailers under pressure, 'dupe' brands and weight-loss drugs gaining share
Australia imposes 'high bar' on fossil-fuel-powered data centres, impacting energy and tech sectors
ASX small-cap runners: X2M, Discovery Alaska, Metal Hawk, Bapcor show speculative momentum
Global: Trump-Venezuela oil deal and Fed policy uncertainty add external volatility

sectors.trend: Pilbara iron ore activity surging; Gateway Resources (GAT.AX) adds 7km gold trend in WA; small-cap miners (X2M, Discovery Alaska, Metal Hawk, Bapcor) leading weekly gains
sectors.implications: Positive for BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX on iron ore momentum; gold discovery supports GAT.AX and broader gold names (NVS.AX, SGH.AX). Small-cap mining speculative flows elevated.

sectors.trend: Housing inflation constrains RBA; deteriorating auction sentiment and 'perfect storm' housing forecast raise credit-risk concerns for lenders
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure if RBA holds rates; housing downturn could elevate NPLs. Defensive dividend appeal intact but growth limited.

sectors.trend: Australia's 'high bar' policy for fossil-fuel data centres creates regulatory headwinds; Trump-Venezuela oil deal adds global supply uncertainty; Virgin hedged against oil shock
sectors.implications: SAP.AX, WDS.AX face policy risk; QAN.AX benefits from hedging. Coal policy push by One Nation (Hanson) could shift energy mix debate.

sectors.trend: Retailers under pressure from cautious consumers; weight-loss drug demand surging; 'dupe' brands gaining; childcare sector in crisis with closures and revenue declines
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX (retail) face soft demand; CSL.AX, SGH.AX benefit from healthcare/weight-loss drug trends. Childcare REITs and operators under stress.

sectors.trend: Global software bounce (Microsoft, Palantir); Nvidia AI chip futures market emerging; Australia restricts fossil-fuel data centres; SpaceX potential AI data centre disruption
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from global AI sentiment but face local energy constraints. International ETFs (VGT, SCHD) as AI proxy exposure.

sectors.trend: Housing 'perfect storm' forecast; auction sentiment deteriorating; houses and households being terminated; Suburban Rail Loop cost overhang in Victoria
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face valuation pressure; construction/infra names (WBC.AX, WES.AX) impacted by SRL delays.

key_themes: Housing market stress as primary domestic risk factor
RBA constrained by housing inflation, limiting rate-cut cycle
Commodity strength (iron ore, gold) supporting materials sector
Energy policy divergence: fossil-fuel data centre restrictions vs coal advocacy
Global AI/tech momentum vs Australian regulatory constraints

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and bank exposure; favour dividend-paying large caps with low leverage; monitor auction clearance rates weekly

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy constraint from housing inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Position for prolonged higher-for-longer rates; favour fixed-income and dividend strategies over growth
Hedge energy exposure; QAN.AX hedging model is a template; monitor Brent crude
Underweight discretionary retail (WES.AX, WBC.AX); favour staples and healthcare

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy policy regulatory risk (data centre restrictions)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor SAP.AX, WDS.AX policy exposure; favour renewables and grid infrastructure plays

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight iron ore and gold miners on commodity strength
opportunities.rationale: Pilbara activity booming; Gateway 7km gold discovery; small-cap mining momentum
Surging Australian demand for weight-loss drugs; CSL and SGH positioned in biotech/healthcare
X2M, Discovery Alaska, Metal Hawk, Bapcor showing relative strength; speculative upside

defensive_moves.rationale: Housing 'perfect storm' forecast; deteriorating auction sentiment; termination of houses/households

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim discretionary retail; favour defensive dividends
defensive_moves.rationale: Consumer caution and retail weakness; banks offer yield but face credit risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge against oil volatility via QAN.AX or energy hedges
defensive_moves.rationale: Virgin's hedging model demonstrates resilience; Trump-Venezuela deal adds uncertainty

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate near recent highs with elevated volatility. Housing data and RBA commentary will dominate. Materials sector provides support; consumer and REITs lag. Watch for any RBA signal on housing inflation trajectory.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from housing correction and constrained RBA policy cap upside. Commodity cycle (iron ore, gold) and healthcare/tech provide selective growth. Energy policy transition creates winners and losers. 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive for materials and healthcare, cautious for financials and property.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and housing inflation commentary
Iron ore and gold price trajectory
Australian data centre energy policy rollout
Housing auction clearance and price data
